votes.motion: to approve the minutes of April 13, 2022. The motion was passed with all voting in favor. *** PUBLIC HEARINGS 1. Darren Nate, representing Ryker Development, LLC requests a partial right-of-way vacation, Preliminary Subdivision, and Conditional Use approval for a project located at approximately 100 W. Center, in the TOD (Transit Oriented Development) zone, to allow for a 26-unit townhome project. Mr. Olsen stated that the public hearing was noticed to begin at 7:00 pm and has asked that the Commission proceed with item two as well as the discussion item and then proceed with public hearing it
that we recommend approval of the request to amend Section 17-7-1.4 of the Midvale City Municipal Code to decrease the rear setback in the Single-Family Residential Zone (SF-1) from 25 to 15 feet

that we recommend denial of the request to amend Section 17-7-1.4 of the Midvale City Municipal Code to decrease the rear setback in the Single-Family Residential Zone (SF-1) from 25 to 15 feet. The Commission finds that the proposed text amendment would provide changes that would affect more residents than those currently affected by this request and find that it may not be in the best interest of the city. The PLANNING AND ZONING COMMISSION APRIL 27, 2022 motion was SECONDED by Commissioner Benson
that we recommend approval of the right- of-way vacation located at approximately 100 West Center with the findings and condition included in the staff report
that we approve the Preliminary Subdivision Plan located at 100 W. Center with the finding and conditions included in the staff report
that we approve the Conditional Use Permit located at 100 W. Center with the finding and condition included in the staff report
